propositions: Five test assertions cannot fail as written because they either re-implement predicates inline rather than calling shared helpers, assert only presence instead of return-value contracts, or use <= comparisons that accept zero as a passing condition.
PAT-repr test constructs a transport without credentials and asserts a literal string is absent from default repr; mutation will show the test is vacuous once __repr__ is added.
Pagination guard teeth test re-implements the AST walk inline instead of calling the shared predicate _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default(), making it immune to mutations of the predicate itself.

validate_assignee_exists return-value test asserts only hasattr(cls, 'validate_assignee_exists') — which the parametrized member-set test already verifies — rather than asserting the method returns a username string and not a bool or accountId.

Rate-limit 429 sweep asserts total <= 1, which passes even when total == 0 (meaning the 429 branch was never reached), and uses blanket pytest.raises(Exception) instead of asserting the specific BackendHTTPError type and .code == 429.
Unknown-backend test asserts only the class relationship (BackendRegistryError is not a KeyError) without exercising select_backend to verify registry lookup behavior.
